title: Govt Disinvests 2.52% Base Stake in Cochin Shipyard via OFS at ₹1,400 Floor Price
summary: Unlocks PSU equity via Offer for Sale (OFS (promoters sell existing shares via exchange)) with an additional 2.52% green-shoe oversubscription option.

blocks.text: 🪝 Govt Disinvests 2.52% Base Stake in Cochin Shipyard via OFS at ₹1,400 Floor Price. Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: Unlocks PSU equity via Offer for Sale (OFS (promoters sell existing shares via exchange)) with an additional 2.52% green-shoe oversubscription option.
Divestment Structure: Base 2.52% stake plus 2.52% green-shoe option at ₹1,400 per share floor price.
Government Stake: Union Government holds 67.91% equity stake in Cochin Shipyard Ltd (CSL).
Disinvestment Target: FY27 budget target set at ₹80,000 crore for PSU disinvestment and asset monetisation.
Base OFS (promoters sell existing shares via exchange) stake (2.52%) vs green-shoe option (2.52%) vs maximum greenshoe limit (15%).
